title: Video Uploads are a Joke
text: My husband and I absolutely love the idea of this app, especially for intimate conversations when we have four children at home.  However, one thing we were really looking forward to sharing are some videos, and the longest video I can get to upload is 45 seconds long.  To share videos you have to upgrade, so we spent the $50 to share videos.  Sending short little video clips is NOT what we were intending, and there is no warning before purchasing that you are limited to small videos.  It’s a total waste of $50.  The other features are nice, like blurring the images in the chat and sending the messages as a notification that has no preview, but if we can’t send longer videos the fee 100% is not worth it.

title: Really wanted to like this
text:
This app has all the right directions but doesn’t deliver on quality. Here is what I liked and did not like:

Liked
-blurred images
-Password protected
-Video upload with paid version
-Color and appearance 

Didn’t like
-Password screen was not always responsive. Reminded me of touch screen phones from a decade ago. 
-Paid version didn’t make the app any more responsive. Videos were painfully slow to upload. 
-App doesn’t allow for “intimately us” to recognize and send things such as sexpert podcasts. How about sharing sex positions with spouse? Would be nice if intimately us could connect with “just between us” where its seem less. 
-Lost messages. Sometimes I would send something or my wife would and it wouldn’t come through. Closing out the app and reopening it would make it appear. 

Overall the app was nice and the concept good. But because of all the negative aspects we decided to not subscribe further. We swapped to “between” which has no lag between messages and and no issues with dropped messages. Plus their password screen is good. 

If just between us solves these issues we would be happy to return to the app.

title: Clunky and unintuitive
text: My wife and I used Couple when u would deploy, now that my wife is on a deployment  we needed an app to chat. We were sad to find out couple was shut down in 2016. We decided on this app. I purchased the lifetime membership, which was a pain as the screen kept auto scrolling to the top. That should have been my first sign to jump ship. While trying to send multiple pictures from my camera roll it won’t allow it, you have to do it one by one. It’s clunky and annoying for an app in 2023. You can save pictures from the chat, but I cannot figure out how to save videos.That’s annoyance #3. Also yesterday’s chat has disappeared, though I have the lifetime membership and thought that it saves indefinitely. And lastly, if you scroll up and your partner starts sending you a message it auto scrolls you to the bottom. It works for not but this app needs a major overhaul with functionality improvements for ease of use to be a player in the couples chat app game.
